import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_82/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_82/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Join Source1 and Source0 on movieId
df = pd.merge(df1, df0, on="movieId", how="inner")

# Ensure columns have correct types as per target schema
df["userId"] = df["userId"].astype(int)
df["movieId"] = df["movieId"].astype(int)
df["rating"] = df["rating"].astype(float)
df["timestamp"] = df["timestamp"].astype(int)
df["title"] = df["title"].astype(str)
df["genres"] = df["genres"].astype(str)

# genres_arr: convert genres string to list of genres (split by '|'), then to string representation of list
df["genres_arr"] = df["genres"].str.split("|").apply(lambda x: str(x))

# genre_count: the first genre in the genres list (string before first '|')
df["genre_count"] = df["genres"].str.split("|").str[0]

# Reorder columns to match target schema
df_target = df[["userId", "movieId", "rating", "timestamp", "title", "genres", "genres_arr", "genre_count"]]

# Write to target CSV without the index
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_82/target_multisource.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
